Advantages & Disadvantages

Pros & Cons

✅
Pros — What Dhan Does Well
  • ✓TradingView Integrated: Full professional TradingView charts built natively into the web platform — free for all users, a major differentiator vs competitors
  • ✓Fastest Order Execution: Among the fastest order placement in India — DEXT engine executes 90%+ of trades under 20ms, critical for F&O and intraday traders
  • ✓Excellent Options Tools: Dedicated options trader interface with live OI charts, payoff diagrams, multi-leg execution — all built-in free
  • ✓Free Algo Trading API: REST API + WebSocket with Python SDK at zero monthly cost — most brokers charge ₹500–₹2,000/month for API access
  • ✓Lifetime Zero Demat AMC: ₹0 AMC for life — no annual maintenance charges unlike Zerodha (₹300/yr) or Angel One
  • ✓Clean UX / Modern App: Rated 4.5★ on App Store/Play Store — minimal, intuitive interface loved by young traders
  • ✓Basket Orders: Execute up to 50 orders in a single click — perfect for hedging F&O portfolios on expiry days
  • ✓Smallcase Integrated: Invest in thematic smallcase portfolios directly from Dhan — added advantage for long-term investors alongside active trading
⚠️
Cons — Limitations of Dhan
  • ✕No Currency Derivatives: USDINR, EURINR and other currency F&O pairs are not available — a major gap vs Zerodha which supports full currency trading
  • ✕No NRI Accounts: NRI demat and trading accounts via PIS route not available — NRIs must use Zerodha, ICICI Direct, or full-service brokers
  • ✕No Joint / Minor Accounts: Joint multi-holder accounts and minor (under-18) accounts are not supported — limits usability for couples and families investing together
  • ✕Limited Ecosystem: No insurance advisory (Ditto-equivalent), no dedicated research platform (Tijori-equivalent) — ecosystem is narrower than Zerodha's though Smallcase is now integrated
  • ✕Younger Company: Founded 2021 — much shorter track record vs Zerodha (2010) or Angel One (1996); strong $1.2Bn unicorn valuation but still a 4-year-old startup
  • ✕No Education Platform: No equivalent to Zerodha Varsity (India's best free trading education) — educational resources limited to blog posts and YouTube
  • ✕Customer Support: Chat and email support only — no dedicated call centre support available for urgent issues during market hours

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Dhan — charges, plans, account types, platforms, and how it compares to other brokers.

What are the brokerage charges on Dhan?+
Dhan offers two pricing plans — a free plan with ₹20 flat fee and a Pro subscription plan with ₹10 per order.
₹0Equity Delivery
₹20F&O (Free Plan)
₹10F&O (Pro Plan)
  • ✓Equity Delivery: ₹0 — completely free on both Free and Pro plans forever
  • ✓Intraday / Futures / Options (Free Plan): ₹20 per executed order or 0.03%, whichever is lower
  • ★Intraday / Futures / Options (Pro Plan): ₹10 per executed order — 50% cheaper for ₹699/month subscription
  • ✓Demat AMC: ₹0 Lifetime Zero AMC — no annual maintenance charges ever, unlike Zerodha (₹300/yr) or Angel One
  • !Call & Trade: ₹50 + GST per order placed via phone support
  • !DP Charges: ₹12.5 + GST per scrip per debit transaction (CDSL charge on equity delivery sells)
⚠️ Statutory charges — STT, exchange transaction fees, SEBI charges, stamp duty, GST — apply on all trades as mandated by SEBI. These are the same for every broker in India.
Is DhanHQ Pro plan worth it? What does it cost?+
DhanHQ Pro is worth it if you trade actively — it reduces your per-order cost from ₹20 to ₹10 for a fixed monthly fee.
₹699Per Month
₹4,999Per Year
35+Orders to Break Even
  • ✓Monthly Plan: ₹699/month — gives you ₹10 flat brokerage on all non-delivery trades vs ₹20 on Free plan
  • ✓Annual Plan: ₹4,999/year — saves ₹3,389 vs monthly billing over 12 months
  • ★Break-even: You need 70 trades/month (saving ₹10/trade × 70 = ₹700) to justify ₹699/month — above 70 trades/month you save money vs the Free plan
  • !Not worth it if: You trade fewer than 35 orders/month — the Free plan at ₹20/order will cost less in brokerage than the subscription fee
⚡ Pro: ₹10/order ✓ Free: ₹20/order Break-even: 70 trades/month Annual saves ₹3,389
Does Dhan support NRI accounts?+
No — Dhan does not support NRI demat or trading accounts as of March 2026. NRIs must use other brokers.
  • !NRE Account: Not available on Dhan — repatriable NRI route not supported
  • !NRO Account: Not available on Dhan — non-repatriable NRI route also not supported
  • ✓Zerodha (Recommended): Supports both NRE and NRO accounts via PIS route — offline process, takes 5–7 days
  • ✓ICICI Direct / HDFC Securities: Full-service brokers with dedicated NRI desks and both online and in-branch support
💡 If you're an NRI looking for a discount broker, Zerodha is the best alternative — free account opening, same ₹20 brokerage on F&O, and full NRI support via PIS route.
Does Dhan have TradingView charts? Is it free?+
Yes — Dhan is the only Indian broker with full TradingView charting built natively into its web platform, completely free for all users.
  • ✓Full TradingView: Not a basic embed — complete TradingView Pro-level functionality with 100+ indicators and drawing tools
  • ✓Completely Free: Available to all Dhan account holders at no extra subscription cost (TradingView Pro normally costs ₹1,500+/month)
  • ✓1-Click Order Entry: Place trades directly from TradingView chart without switching to a separate order window
  • ★Saves Money: Standalone TradingView Pro subscription costs ₹1,500/month — Dhan users get equivalent charts free with their account
✓ 100+ Indicators ★ Completely Free 1-Click Orders Saves ₹1,500/month
What account types does Dhan NOT support?+
Dhan supports Individual, HUF, Corporate, LLP, Partnership, and Trust accounts. Joint, NRI, and Minor accounts are NOT available on Dhan.
  • ✓HUF Account: ✅ Fully supported — Dhan is India's first broker with 100% online HUF account opening. Complete in just 10 minutes with no couriers or branch visits needed. Free opening, Lifetime Zero AMC.
  • !Joint Account: Multi-holder accounts with up to 3 individuals not available — use Zerodha or HDFC Securities instead
  • !NRI Account (NRE/NRO): Non-Resident Indian accounts via PIS route not available — use Zerodha, ICICI Direct, or HDFC
  • !Minor Account: Demat accounts for under-18 individuals not supported — use Zerodha which offers both online and offline minor accounts
💡 For the most complete account type support, Zerodha supports all 8 account types including NRI, HUF (online), Joint, Minor, Foreign National, Corporate, and Persons with Disabilities — all with free account opening.
Does Dhan support Currency Derivatives (USDINR)?+
No — Currency Derivatives including USDINR, EURINR, GBPINR and JPYINR are NOT available on Dhan as of March 2026.
  • !USDINR / EURINR: Currency futures and options on NSE's Currency Derivatives Segment not supported on Dhan
  • !No Alternative on Dhan: There is no currency hedging tool or forex derivative product currently available through Dhan
  • ✓Use Zerodha instead: Zerodha supports full currency derivatives — USDINR, EURINR, GBPINR, JPYINR futures and options at ₹20/order
  • ℹOther options: Angel One and Upstox also support currency derivatives if you prefer an alternative to Zerodha
⚠️ If currency hedging for import/export business or speculative currency trading is important to you, Dhan is not the right broker — choose Zerodha, Angel One, or Upstox.
How does Dhan compare to Zerodha for active traders?+
Both offer ₹20 flat F&O brokerage — but Dhan wins on execution speed and free TradingView, while Zerodha wins on ecosystem breadth and account types.
  • ★Dhan advantage — Speed: Consistently faster order execution; TradingView charts free for all; cleaner mobile app UI for traders
  • ★Dhan advantage — API: Free algo trading API vs Zerodha's Kite Connect which charges ₹2,000/month for API access
  • ✓Zerodha advantage — Ecosystem: Sensibull (options), Streak (algo), Varsity (education), Coin (MF), Ditto (insurance) — unmatched partner ecosystem
  • ✓Zerodha advantage — Account types: Supports NRI, Joint, Minor, Foreign National accounts — Dhan doesn't offer these. Zerodha's HUF is also online, but Dhan has pioneered a faster 10-minute HUF process.
  • !Zerodha advantage — Financial safety: ₹22,679Cr in cash reserves vs Dhan being a startup (founded 2021) — Zerodha is far more financially secure
💡 Choose Dhan if you're an active F&O/intraday trader who values speed, charts, and free API — or want India's fastest HUF online onboarding. Choose Zerodha if you need NRI accounts, joint accounts, minor accounts, currency derivatives, or a richer partner ecosystem.
What is Dhan's account opening process and how long does it take?+
Dhan's account opening is 100% paperless, free, and typically completes within 24–72 hours via Aadhaar eKYC.
  • ✓Step 1 — Sign Up: Visit dhan.co or download the app. Enter mobile number and complete OTP verification
  • ✓Step 2 — KYC: Submit PAN card details and complete Aadhaar eKYC via DigiLocker — takes under 5 minutes
  • ✓Step 3 — e-Sign: Digitally sign your application using Aadhaar OTP — no physical documents or courier needed
  • ✓Step 4 — Active: Account activated within 1–3 business days — you'll get login credentials via SMS and email
✓ ₹0 Opening Fee ✓ 100% Paperless ⏱ 1–3 Days Activation Aadhaar eKYC
💡 Required documents: PAN card + Aadhaar card (linked to mobile). Bank account for fund transfers. Webcam or phone camera for live photo verification.
Final Verdict

Dhan: Best for Active F&O Traders

Dhan is India's fastest-growing discount broker — purpose-built for active traders who prioritise execution speed, advanced charting, and free API access. The DEXT engine executes 90%+ of trades under 20ms, TradingView is built-in free, Smallcase is integrated, and the Lifetime Zero Demat AMC is a standout advantage. Dhan launched the DEXTT3 Trading Terminal in March 2026 for super traders. However, it lacks currency derivatives, NRI/Joint/Minor account support. Dhan became a unicorn in Oct 2025 at $1.2Bn valuation ($120M Series B from Hornbill Capital and MUFG) — with ₹887Cr revenue and ₹408Cr profit in FY25, financial fundamentals are strong for a 4-year-old startup.
